written_by: Desi, after the founder closed the request for drawn faces (2026-11-20) and answered it with generated ones
note: Who may be drawn, and from what. A player listed here is a CHARACTER — a game's invention, not a member of the commons — and its face is composed from the sentence below by portrait.js, every time the card is drawn. A player not listed here keeps the monogram: a participant is not given a face by me, only a member can accept one. The sentences follow CAST.md and the hair in seasons/2026-spring/setup.json, so the face and the body are the same person.

Ada.face: mid-brown hair in a high ponytail, intent and unsmiling, an olive complexion, a long face

Remy.face: very dark hair cropped close, clean-shaven, a considering look, a long lean face
